title: Enterprise Dual-Plane Logging & Storage Architecture
preview:
id: dual plane architecture title: Enterprise Dual Plane Logging & Storage Architecture sidebar label: Dual Plane Architecture slug: /logging audit/dual plane architecture import Tabs from '@theme/Tabs'; import TabItem from '@theme/TabItem'; Enterprise Dual Plane Logging & Storage Architecture Telehealth systems generate massive amounts of telemetry: debug traces, query execution timings, client heartbeats, clinical document accesses, and payment events. Traditional single destination logging creates two catastrophic failure modes: 1. The Disk Full Crash : Writing all logs to local disk without strict rolling limits fills the server drive and crashes containers. 2. The Database Bloat Crash : Writing every trace, click, or authentication denial into PostgreSQL inflates table sizes to gigabytes, exhausts the 8 connection HikariCP pool, and halts clinical bookings. To permanently solve this, HITHA enforces the Dual Plane Logging Strategy .

title: Server-Sent Events (SSE) & Seamless Token Refresh Lifecycle
preview: id: sse token refresh title: Server Sent Events SSE & Seamless Token Refresh Lifecycle sidebar label: SSE & JWT Renewal Handshake slug: /security/sse token refresh import Tabs from '@theme/Tabs'; import TabItem from '@theme/TabItem'; Server Sent Events SSE & Seamless Token Refresh Lifecycle Real time notifications in HITHA appointment bookings, payment confirmations, doctor call rings are delivered using persistent Server Sent Events SSE over HTTP streaming. 🔄 The Token Expiration Handshake <Tabs> <TabItem value="sinhala" label="📖 සරල සිංහලෙන් Plain Sinhala " default> ගැටලුව : SSE connection එකක් කියන්නේ server එක සහ browser එක අතර දිගටම ඇරලා තියෙන persistent line එකක්. User ගේ JWT access token එක විනාඩි 15කින් expire වෙනවා. කලින් token එක expire වුණු ගමන් SSE line එක කැඩිලා user ට notification එන එක නැවතුණා. විසඳුම : Backend එකෙන් token එක expire වෙන්න විනාඩියකට කලින් SSE line එක හරහා TOKEN REFRESH REQUIRED කියලා silent signal එකක් browser එකට යවනවා.
